meta.title: SLW Hub shared physics constants + formula strings
meta.disclaimer: Educational / contested. SLW is not settled physics. Numbers are hub toys for Mathematica bit-for-bit parity with js/fields.js and experiment-c-snr.html — not lab calibration. No invented equations; HYP/toy/illustrative flagged.
sources: US 12,525,711 (Keyport sleeve); US 9,306,527 Eq.15; Hively-Loebl 2019 + 2022 Errata

hypLabels: TinySA Ultra gen max −19 dBm (NOT +10) — FACT from tinysa.org TinySA4.Specification
I_rms from 50 Ω assumes matched load; antenna Z≠50 Ω → I_antenna is HYP without S11
Φ / C educational framing — page plots A_m (NZ) and A_z (Zimmerman); no separate invented Φ formula
Errata 2022 α=0 for irrotational SLW (EED prediction) vs Exp-C Ohmic α (empirical/HYP) — BOTH flags kept
Media α_ohm / stack Ohmic for sensitivity studies are HYP/illustrative — DO NOT use Cross-Sectional attenFactor 0.95
Linearly Resistive steel μ_r=1 is a JS simplification (physically incomplete)
Patent US 12,525,711 optional sphere radius=λ/4 ≠ Dan LAB spheres KB-1820 / KB-2016 — label PATENT vs LAB
US 12,562,930 is sensor/DAQ — DO NOT use for balun dims
cable limits: Ultra alone never thermally limits coax; PA path needs separate ceiling
NO standard RG-450/U — sleeve host RG-405/U; jumpers RG-316-class

formulas.NZ_Am: A_m(r) = MU0 * I_peak / (2*pi*k0*r)   # Wb/m peak; k0=2*pi*f/c
formulas.ohmic_S: S = S_geom * exp(-alpha_ohm * L)   # experiment-c-snr; Errata/SW → alpha=0
formulas.E_parallel_illustrative: E_parallel ≈ sqrt(S * Z0)   # HYP/illustrative; also printed in Hively-SNR-Simulator
formulas.near_field_flag: far ≈ 2*D^2/lambda with D≈lambda/4; flag when r < far (Friis caveat)
